author: Sol 6.1 / extra high

space.anchor: bottom centre; clear_box is relative to this anchor, axes identical to box_size
space.rotation: ItemVisual correction already included, no second half-turn

capacity.limitations: Counts are average planning capacities at 0.18 m per folded item. Runtime packs by actual remaining height; thick items reduce the count. Helmet places are single-item spaces.

fill_order: Typed compatible bays only, native size, supported lower layers before upper, front before rear. No manual armor-stand keys.
runtime_needed: Group folded records by support_stack_id; shared fixed clear_box is the complete pile, not a box per layer.

Pack folded piles bottom-up by true item height/contact. Ordinary planning counts are 3 cabinet or 5 coffer per pile; wide pile counts follow layout.layers (cabinet 3/2/2/2, coffer 3/1). Do not guarantee these counts for 0.53 m thick items.
Place classes are place: ordinary folded pile, wide folded pile, standard helmet, oversized helmet. Helmets remain one item per record.
Use strict clear_box and native scale. Yaw may turn items to fit; oversized helmet places accept every Helmet type, including small helmets.
Use class rows with helmet/chest/legs/cape hints. Counts are physical capacities, no silent 64-slot promise.

allocation_policy.fit: rotated true mesh bounds must fit clear_box exactly; NO x1.25 and NO +2cm
allocation_policy.special: Prefer ordinary folded piles for narrow items and wide piles for large folded items. All helmet places accept Helmet; oversized places are available for any helmet.
allocation_policy.support: allocate each stack bottom-up; upper absent unless a lower item exists; actual triangle contact, no exemplar pitch
allocation_policy.overflow: No shrinking. Windows owns class-row capacity and actual-height packing; do not silently promise the r2 64-slot inventory.

clear_box_contract.scope: largest centred box within the reserved place domain; shared stack layers share that domain
clear_box_contract.method: re-read Frame.obj triangles; exact triangle/axis-aligned-box polygon clipping; boundary contact allowed; binary search to 34 steps
clear_box_contract.dimensions: grow reserved width, then depth, then maximum height; frame or domain boundary stops each axis
clear_box_contract.stacking: clear_box fixed in prefab space; move copy bottom by actual contact and test remaining height to fixed ceiling
